description: Hand mechanical edits to a cheaper agent, ask another model, or get a ranked decision without leaving the turn. route_worker runs a task on any BB harness and model you list, in the same environment, and returns its final message. route_ask sends one prompt to any OpenAI-compatible API, and route_decide asks a System One decision model such as TypeSafe Jev for a pick with probabilities. Each tool needs its own provider or endpoint and key, billed by that service.
